name: resource-explorer-frontend-build
description: Build step for bundled (non-CDN) frontend assets — Tailwind CSS plus vendored marked/plotly.js/svg-pan-zoom — for resource_explorer/web/static/index.html, plus a second, independent Tailwind entry (tailwind-next.config.js) for the experimental /next UI. Mermaid renders server-side via Kroki instead (see diagrams.py), so it isn't vendored here.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:css:next && npm run build:vendor
